subject: general
question:
Simplify

13.5 - [5 + 0.5 × (9 - 3 × 2)]
solution:
**Given:**

13.5 - [5 + 0.5 × (9 - 3 × 2)]

**Formula used:**

Order of Operations (BODMAS/BIDMAS): Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction

**Calculations:**

13.5 - [5 + 0.5 × (9 - 3 × 2)]

⇒ 13.5 - [5 + 0.5 × (9 - 6)]

⇒ 13.5 - [5 + 0.5 × 3]

⇒ 13.5 - [5 + 1.5]

⇒ 13.5 - 6.5

⇒ 7

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
